premises.text: Women lack everyday guidance and data on fluctuating hormone levels outside fertility contexts; multi-day blood testing is inconvenient and costly
premises.evidence_span: Today's data on cyclical hormone levels unrelated to fertility and pregnancy isn't just thin on the ground, it barely exists

premises.text: Patent-pending non-invasive urine tests for three key hormones give quantitative results at home in about 15 minutes without a lab, cheaper than blood testing
premises.evidence_span: decreased the time it takes for you to get your test results from five days to 15 minutes

premises.text: Mobile app algorithm schedules testing days per cycle, analyzes scanned tests, shows hormone patterns, and links symptoms to tips and treatments
premises.evidence_span: unique hormonal algorithm indicates the three testing days per cycle alongside which hormone to test

value.text: Women understand their individual hormone patterns from home and can act on symptoms and life planning
value.evidence_span: empowers women to understand their hormones from the comfort of our home

secondary_value.text: Build the hormonal baseline medicine will work from and narrow the gender data gap
secondary_value.evidence_span: creating the hormonal baseline that medicine will be working off of

causal_links.evidence_span: Who's there to tell us if a change is expected, normal, or abnormal? Today, no one
completely removed the need for a lab
understand how symptoms connect to their hormone levels

notes: Menopause/fertility detection framed as outcomes of regular testing folded into P2/P3 rather than separate premises. Blue-ocean first-mover market talk treated as framing. Founder story used as need illustration inside P1, not bio premise. Anti-template: need / assay / app insights separately revisable.
